worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.summary: Bite the target, possibly causing paralysis or flinching. Biting an already paralyzed target briefly roots it.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.use.2: Lock an already paralyzed target in place
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.descriptio: The bite deals about %1$s contact and bite damage over a fang radius of %2$s blocks; the target's defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.
A hit has a %1$s chance to run current through the target, paralyzing it for %2$s (half movement speed, a 25%% chance for its actions to fail).
If the target was already paralyzed when bitten, the current locks its seizing muscles in place, unable to move, for %1$s.
A hit has a %1$s chance to wince the target, interrupting interruptible actions; while flinching for %2$s it cannot start new moves or make ordinary attacks.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.overload.o: Overload style: easier and longer paralysis and a longer electric lock, but a lighter bite and a longer cooldown.
Point-strike style: a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but shorter paralysis and a shorter lock.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and the paralysis chance to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.thunderfang.preference: On: paralysis chance +12%%, paralysis duration x1.2, electric lock x1.6, but bite power x0.88 and cooldown +4 ticks, for control. Off (point strike): a heavier bite and a faster cycle, but shorter paralysis and a shorter lock.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The thunder fang reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: already fully paralyzed targets rank first, since this bite locks them in place; a target that is running ranks higher still. Off: order by ordinary melee only.
